response.title: what else do i need to buy with a solar generator
response.answer:
If you're buying a solar generator (portable power station), there are a few other things you may need to buy to make it work properly, especially if you want backup power during outages or electricity for camping.

The good news is that most solar generators already have a battery, inverter, and charge controller built in.

What else you'll need

Item

	

Do you need it?

	

Purpose




Solar panels

	

Yes, for solar charging

	

Recharge the generator using sunlight




Solar charging cable

	

Usually

	

Connects the panels to the generator




Extension cord

	

Recommended

	

Lets you power appliances farther away




Extra battery

	

Optional

	

Gives you longer backup power




Solar panel stand or mount

	

Optional

	

Helps position panels toward the sun




Surge protector

	

Optional

	

Adds outlets and protection for compatible devices




Transfer switch

	

For home circuits

	

Allows safe connection to selected household circuits, with professional installation

Important: Make sure the solar panels' voltage, wattage, and connectors are compatible with your generator. Don't connect a generator directly to a home outlet.

A couple of accessories to consider

200W N-Type Portable Solar Panel with 4-in-1 Extension Cable…

$224.99 · Renogy US

Portable solar panel with an adapter cable. Compatibility depends on your generator model.

Farship 10' 12 AWG Universal Solar Extension Cable MC4 Conne…

$17.99 · Walmart - Myecovie Co., Ltd

Extension cable for positioning compatible solar panels farther away.

What brand and model is your solar generator?
What will you use it for?
Home backup during power outages
Camping or RV
Running a refrigerator, AC, or appliances
Powering an off-grid home or cabin
